span.i:
Both claims come from hardcoded protocol mappers on the client.
"scopes" is a separate array so it does not collide with Keycloak's
own space-separated "scope" string.

div.span:
The workspace claim is the step that costs the most debugging time
The gateway is documented to fall back to the organization's default workspace when a token
carries no workspace claim. On this integration path that fallback does not resolve reliably, and
every completion returns Following keys are not valid: openai even though the
identical request works with a plain API key.
Embed the workspace explicitly, and use the slug (ws-example-a-7c41b9), never the
display name (main_airs_workspace_4471206350).
